cim: Forgent Power Solutions to invest $3 million in downtown Columbus office, add 85 jobs
cim_eredeti: Forgent Power Solutions to invest $3 million in downtown Columbus office, add 85 jobs
szoveg_eredeti:
COLUMBUS, Ohio (WSYX) — As artificial intelligence drives demand for the equipment that powers data centers, downtown Columbus is poised for a major corporate expansion.

Forgent Power Solutions plans to invest $3 million in a new office on Nationwide Boulevard. The company designs and manufactures electrical distribution equipment.

The 90,000-square-foot office will support customer service and other company operations. The expansion is expected to add 85 jobs and generate $12 million in annual payroll.
